pr.title: feat(engine): route events by repo pattern, not just source
pr.body:
feat(engine): route events by repo pattern, not just source

<!-- git-stk:description -->
Routes can now be scoped to specific repos, so one source's events fan out to different destinations by origin — e.g. work repos to Slack, personal repos to email.

`[[routes]]` gains an optional `repos` glob list (same syntax as `rules.repos`: `owner/*`, `owner/prefix-*`, `*/prefix-*`). A route fires when its source matches **and** its `repos` are empty (all repos, back-compat) or match the event's repo. Routing moved from per-source to per-event; every matching route's destination receives the event (fan-out). With no routes configured at all, the old "every destination" fallback stands. The repo matcher is shared with `rules.repos` so globs behave identically.

Closes #11.
<!-- /git-stk:description -->

<!-- git-stk:closes -->
Closes #11
<!-- /git-stk:closes -->
